provenance.credential_input: stdin only; use the password already published by the challenge author, no guessing
provenance.redistribution: Only this manifest is committed; archive, container, encrypted partition and decrypted oracle stay in private .build

container.name: secret_data.vhdx
container.reader: dissect.hypervisor 3.21, regular-file read only; no parent, active log or Windows mount

oracle.implementation: libbde-python / pybde, independently implemented BitLocker reader
oracle.digest_origin: Observed full libbde output on 2026-11-13; not a plaintext digest published by the challenge author
oracle.comparison: Every byte of independent libbde output is compared with every product byte; no boot-sector-only or self-generated ciphertext oracle

limits: One externally authored AES-128-CBC volume and password protector; not all BitLocker ciphers or protector types
The independent oracle and product share only the VHDX-to-raw container materialization, not BitLocker decryption
BitLocker authenticates key metadata, not all data sectors; exact comparison proves this fixture only
No physical device, GUI, Windows native encryption, TPM, credential recovery or filesystem mount
